nodes.name: Daily 10am IST
nodes.notes: Assumes n8n server runs UTC: 04:30 UTC = 10:00 IST. If container TZ changes, update the cron.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ ({"model": "claude-haiku-4-5", "max_tokens": 3000, "temperature": 0.3, "system": "You are an AI assistant for Chicking Mohali franchise pipeline. VERIFIED FACTS: Investment Rs60 Lakhs+, Royalty 6%, Outlets 475+ in 45+ countries. COMPLIANCE (hard rules): never state or imply payback, ROI, returns, EBITDA or any earnings projection; never mention halal; investment is 'Rs60 Lakhs+' only; no unconfirmed opening dates LEAD TIERS: HOT=80-100 (location+capital+background confirmed), WARM=40-79 (active interest), COLD=0-39 (enquiry only). TARGET CITIES (HIGH): Mohali, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Delhi NCR, Amritsar. BRAND VOICE: Warm, professional, confident. No exclamation spam. Max 1 emoji. Sign-off: Team Chicking Mohali", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": ('Chicking Mohali Franchise Pipeline — internal daily digest for the franchise team.
'+ 'Date: ' + $now.format('dd LLL yyyy') + '

'+ 'B2B FRANCHISE / INVESTOR LEADS (last 24 hours):
' + JSON.stringify($('Fetch B2B Leads').first().json.leads||[]) + '

'+ 'B2C CUSTOMER WAITLIST LEADS (last 24 hours):
' + JSON.stringify($('Fetch B2C Leads').first().json.leads||[]) + '

'+ 'Produce a polished professional HTML email body. RULES:
'+ '- Output ONLY raw HTML with inline CSS. No markdown. No triple backtick code fences. No html or body tags.
'+ '- Clean card-based layout, brand accent colour #BE1622, readable on mobile and desktop.
'+ '- Sections in order: 1) Header card with the title Chicking Mohali Franchise Pipeline Daily Digest and the date. 2) A KPI row of small cards: B2B Leads, B2C Waitlist, Hot Leads, Actions Due. 3) FRANCHISE and INVESTOR LEADS: a tier table with rows Hot, Warm, Cold and Pending Score, then a city breakdown and key lead profiles. 4) A SEPARATE CUSTOMER WAITLIST section, not mixed with franchise leads and without investor or budget language. 5) Priority Actions Today, numbered and specific. 6) Footer.
'+ '- VOCABULARY: leads with no score are described as Newly captured, pending qualification and counted under Pending Score; never label an unscored lead as Cold. If there are no overdue follow-ups, write the line No overdue follow-ups at this stage.
'+ '- Keep franchise/investor (B2B) and customer waitlist (B2C) strictly separate and clearly labelled.
'+ '- The footer must contain: Confidential — prepared for Chicking Mohali by Rudra Digital. Workflow automation operated by the processing engine. And: © 2026 Rudra Digital.
'+ '- Use the wording Chicking Mohali Franchise Pipeline; do not claim official Chicking brand ownership. No halal. No earnings, ROI or payback figures.
'+ '- Keep it under 600 words. Professional, scannable, data-first.')}]}) }}

={{ ({"model": "claude-haiku-4-5", "max_tokens": 100, "temperature": 0.1, "system": "You are a compliance auditor for the Chicking Mohali INTERNAL daily pipeline digest (franchise team only). Respond EXACTLY: PASS or FAIL: <one sentence>. AUTO-FAIL ONLY on a genuine compliance violation: halal reference; revenue/ROI/payback/EBITDA projection or earnings forecast; guaranteed or fixed returns; an outlet count other than 475+ or country count other than 45+; a specific unconfirmed opening date. This is an internal report - it MAY name leads and repeat lead-provided cities and investment ranges; do NOT fail it for naming leads or reporting their stated data. If there is no compliance violation, respond PASS.", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": ('Audit this daily report for Ajay Kumar. Check brand facts, no unconfirmed promises, professional tone.\n'+ 'Draft preview: ' + $json.content[0].text)}]}) }}

={{ ({ from: 'Chicking Mohali <contact@rudradigital.uk>', to: ['chandervikas@gmail.com'], reply_to: 'contact@rudradigital.uk', subject: 'Chicking Mohali Franchise Pipeline — Daily Digest | ' + $now.format('dd LLL yyyy'), html: ($('LLM Digest Generator').first().json.content[0].text || '').replace(/```html/gi,'').replace(/```/g,'').trim() }) }}
={{ ({'chat_id':'1809294875','parse_mode':'HTML','text':'✅ Daily digest sent to Ajay — ' + $now.format('DD MMM YYYY HH:mm')}) }}
={{ ({'chat_id':'1809294875','parse_mode':'HTML','text':'⚠️ W3 Digest Audit Failed\nReason: ' + $json.content[0].text + '\nDigest NOT sent — manual review.'}) }}
